E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lela's: In California, Gordon Ramsay visits Lela's, a fine dining restaurant run by inexperienced owner Lela and young chef Ricky. Can Gordon save them from complete disaster? (S1 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2005) Fantasy adventure from the world of Jumanji. A mysterious board game plunges two brothers deep into space, where dangerous aliens lurk.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Flandshees of Innersimpson: Flanders vows never to speak to Homer again after Homer steals his new headphones. Homer's absolutely delighted - at first... (S36 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Man Expanding: Springfield's hooked on a weight loss drug. Homer's not sold on it, until Marge begs him to take it. But there's a side effect... (S36 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: P.S. I Hate You: Marge's reputation as Springfield's nicest resident is jeopardised when her secret stash of vitriolic letters is stolen during a house party. (S36 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Abe League of Their Moe: Grampa and Moe bond over baseball, and hatch a plan to make the Springfield Isotopes great again. (S36 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stew Lies: Homer's obsessed with an extreme eating show. Somehow, that ends up with him getting chased by the mob when a stew recipe is stolen from Fat Tony. (S36 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Let's Go Fly a Coot: Bart develops a crush on Milhouse's Dutch cousin. And the family learn about Grampa's days in the Air Force. (S26 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bull-E: Bart is picked on at the school dance, so Marge convinces Springfield's authorities to pass anti-bullying legislation. But then Homer's arrested for victimising Ned. (S26 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mathlete's Feat: Groundskeeper Willie coaches Lisa and the school Mathlympics team for an important maths quiz. (S26 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: The Great Australian Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Spice Week: The competition heats up as the six remaining bakers spice up their lives with filo pastries, colourful crullers and showstopping 3D structures. (S7 Ep7/10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Deep Impact

E4Plus1.uk.title: American Pie
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1999) Coming-of-age comedy with Jason Biggs. Four high school senior boys enter a pact to lose their virginity before prom, while exploring the appeal of baked goods.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching The Masked Singer, Trigger Point, Pam & Tommy, First Dates: Valentine's, Mary Beard's Forgotten Art, and Dragons' Den. (S19 Ep1) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: TV's most daring dating show. Pansexual Izzy is open to all genders. Dom's looking for a woman who isn't put off by his posh boy charm. (S2 Ep1/5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cruise: Peralta and Santiago set off on their first real holiday together. Gina and Jeffords help Captain Holt to survive a visit from his sister Debbie. (S3 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Karen Peralta: On his birthday, Peralta takes Santiago to meet his mother. Diaz and Boyle struggle to deal with a new mandate on body cams during a stakeout. (S3 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jenson plans to double cross Gemma. Abigail begins to put down roots in the village. And the teens must face the consequences.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's the summer of love for two teens as Maddox and Dee Dee grow closer. Elsewhere, girls' night ends in panic. And is there hope for a broken relationship, or is it too late?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
